result.topic_en: Draft of Riemann's lecture announcement for the winter semester 1858/59, listing a course on theoretical physics (electricity and heat) and one on functions of a variable complex quantity, with an algebraic simplification at the top.

methods.what: Algebraic simplification of a rational expression by factoring the denominator, $\mu^4-\mu^4\varepsilon^2-1+\mu^2\varepsilon^2=(\mu^2-1)(\mu^2+1-\mu^2\varepsilon^2)$, reducing it to denominator $\mu^2+1-\mu^2\varepsilon^2$
